summary_zh: 按2026-10-18至2026-10-25（Asia/Shanghai）的过去一周窗口复核，并与最新远端目录去重。本周未发现值得收录的新文献（指本轮去重后尚未收录的确定本周首发文献）；补收录2篇2025年语言模型零阶预训练研究。另补齐今天先前已收录2篇文献的书目，明确参数与反传边界，并将Noise基准作为Dust的关联资源加入。GitHub目录由253条增至255条。
limitations_zh: 只使用明确方法关键词与精确题名发现候选；未抓取通用语言模型语料或会议全量投稿。OpenReview检索索引混有无关链接，未把这些结果作为新收录依据。仅核实原始摘要、机构研究页面及Delta N-gram部分方法段落，未宣称阅读全文或独立复现实验。主工作目录252条及其既有未提交修改继续保留，本轮在独立工作区发布。

before.title: Lower Bounds for Smooth Nonconvex Zeroth-Order Optimization: The Price of Determinism under Low Curvature Trace
before.description_en: Proves that under a low-curvature-trace (effective-rank) condition the Gaussian two-point method used in ZO fine-tuning, with rejection of loss-increasing steps, attains the optimal query cost among randomized methods, whereas every deterministic method pays an extra factor that grows roughly linearly with dimension; a theory paper motivated by ZO language-model fine-tuning.
before.description_zh: 证明在低曲率迹（有效秩）条件下，ZO 微调所用的高斯两点法（拒绝使损失上升的步）在随机化方法中查询代价最优，而任何确定性方法都要多付出一个大致随维度线性增长的因子；属于以零阶语言模型微调为动机的理论工作。

after.title: Lower Bounds for Smooth Nonconvex Zeroth-Order Optimization: The Price of Determinism under Low Curvature Trace
after.description_en: Analyzes query-complexity bounds for randomized and deterministic ZO algorithms under low curvature trace. This is theory, with no actual LM training or persistent model-parameter updates; not a new LM fine-tuning algorithm. Assumptions, formal proofs and acceptance remain unverified.
after.description_zh: 在低曲率迹假设下研究随机与确定性零阶算法的查询复杂度界；属于理论研究，不实际训练语言模型或更新持久模型参数，不能计作新的语言模型微调算法。理论假设、形式化证明与录用状态待核实。

This is theory, with no actual LM training or persistent model-parameter updates; not a new LM fine-tuning algorithm. Assumptions, formal proofs and acceptance remain unverified.

review.persistent_parameters: 不更新实际语言模型参数；研究抽象优化算法。

before.title: Delta N-gram: Forward-Only Continual Writing into a Language Model's Native N-gram Memory
before.description_en: Writes new evidence into a sparse, removable patch over a language model's native hashed N-gram table using forward passes only: a small writer trained offline with the pretraining objective emits gated targets that a block-averaged delta rule mixes into the addressed rows; the persistent state is a memory patch rather than ES/ZO parameter optimization, and the writer itself is trained with gradients.
before.description_zh: 只用前向传播把新证据写入语言模型原生哈希 N-gram 表上可清除的稀疏补丁：离线以预训练目标训练的小型写入器给出带门控的目标，再由分块平均的 delta 规则混入对应行；持久状态是记忆补丁而非 ES/ZO 参数优化，写入器本身用梯度训练。

after.title: Delta N-gram: Forward-Only Continual Writing into a Language Model's Native N-gram Memory
after.description_en: At use time, a forward-only delta rule updates a removable persistent N-gram memory patch; backbone, pretrained table and writer weights stay frozen. The roughly 4.1M-parameter writer is trained offline with backpropagation. The patch is memory state, not use-time backbone-weight training or strict function-value ZO.
after.description_zh: 使用时以纯前向delta规则更新可清除的持久N-gram记忆补丁；骨干、预训练表及写入器权重冻结。约4.1M参数写入器在离线阶段通过反传训练，因此不属于全流程无反传或严格函数值零阶优化。补丁是记忆状态，不把它混称为使用时训练骨干权重。

before.title: Dust: Pretraining Transformers Without Backpropagation
before.description_en: Trains transformer language-model weights using token-wise activation perturbations and loss-based credit assignment, with weight-space ES for residual mixing scalars; large-population comparisons require more compute and the claimed EGGROLL efficiency gains include extrapolation.
before.description_zh: 通过逐词元激活扰动和损失反馈分配学习信号，训练语言模型权重，并对残差混合标量使用权重空间 ES；大种群比较需要更多计算，相对 EGGROLL 的效率优势包含外推估计。
